name: Glenn Foundation for Medical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship in Aging Research
funder: Glenn Foundation for Medical Research / American Federation for Aging Research (AFAR)
other_rules: Postdocs (MD, PhD or equivalent) at any training level, degree held by the LOI deadline
more than 5 years of postdoc training must be justified
not NIH intramural staff, not in labs funded by a Paul F. Glenn Center, not former awardees
notes: Biology of aging. 2026 cycle: LOI 27 Jan 2026, full applications by invitation in late June; next cycle expected on a similar schedule. Up to 12 awards; possible second year through a Continuation Award.
